prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1363; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient is a synthetic test case presenting with lumbar strain following a side-impact collision at an intersection. Initial presentation included paraspinal muscle tenderness, restricted lumbar range of motion, and pain radiating into the left buttock without neurological deficit. Imaging showed no acute fracture, and the working diagnosis was soft tissue injury to the lumbar region.

Over the course of 28 visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for core and lumbar stabilization, and a home exercise program with progressive loading. Pain was managed with NSAIDs during the early phase, with gradual tapering as symptoms improved. Range of motion and functional tolerance for sitting and lifting improved steadily across the treatment period.

At discharge, the patient reported residual intermittent low back discomfort with prolonged sitting, though pain intensity had decreased substantially from baseline. Lumbar mobility was near functional norms, and neurological examination remained intact. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program, avoid heavy lifting until fully conditioned, and return for reassessment if symptoms worsen or new neurological signs develop.
